video_caption: The video opens with a close-up shot of a person's profile, looking down and to the right, with blurred, warm-toned lights in the background. This transitions to a wider shot of a gray van with its back doors open, revealing a person in a blue denim jacket with a tiger design loading boxes into it, while another person in a denim shirt watches from the side. The camera then cuts back to the initial person's profile, now looking slightly upward. A new scene shows a person with dreadlocks energetically playing a drum set on a stage, with the drum head displaying "Ludwig" and "XAXX." This is followed by a shot of the same person in a car, looking directly at the camera with a serious expression, their dreadlocks dyed black and blonde. The video then shows the person on stage again, singing into a microphone with a crowd in front, their cell phone flashlights illuminating the dark venue. A text overlay appears on the screen, reading "XXL will write an article about a certain rapper no matter what* complex doesnt" (XXL will write an article about a certain rapper no matter what* complex doesn't), suggesting that XXL magazine covers artists regardless of their background, while Complex magazine might not. The person on stage is seen again, wearing a plaid shirt and camouflage pants, continuing to perform. The video then transitions to a split screen: on the left, the person in the plaid shirt is seen standing in a room, and on the right, their face is shown in close-up, with visible tattoos on their face and neck and bright purple dreadlocks. This transitions to a mugshot of the person with dark hair and a white collared shirt, against a white background. The video concludes with the person in a light blue denim jacket speaking into a microphone in front of a black backdrop with the "iHeartRADIO" logo.

The video segment captures a nighttime outdoor scene, likely a street or parking lot, illuminated by streetlights and a blue glow. In the foreground, a young man with distinct light-colored dreadlocks with dark roots, wearing a black shirt with a green and black striped collar and a dark chest strap, is initially seen holding and then handing a black, folded item to an unseen person at the very right of the frame. He then turns to face another young man with dark, slicked-back hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a dark jacket draped over his left shoulder. The two shake hands, after which the dreadlocked man points his finger while speaking, his expression serious and focused. The man in the white t-shirt listens attentively with a slight smile, revealing tattoos on his right arm and wearing a necklace and an earring. Several other young men, diverse in appearance and mostly wearing dark shirts, stand in the background, observing the interaction.

The video opens with an image of four iPhone X models, two in black and two in white, displayed side-by-side against a blurred background featuring a person with dreadlocks. This image then subtly blurs further, making the iPhones less distinct. At the 0:07 mark, the scene transitions to a medium shot of a person with light-colored dreadlocks, wearing a dark, possibly brown, hoodie, sitting with their head slightly bowed and looking down, as if at something in their hands. The background is completely black, focusing attention on the person. At 0:12, white text appears on the screen, overlaying the person: "comment 'XXXTTENTACION is better than Complex' for a shoutout in the next video!". The person in the hoodie remains in a similar posture, but slightly raises their head. The scene then quickly cuts at 0:17 to a close-up of a different person, likely the same individual, with dreadlocks, wearing a black and white plaid shirt and a prominent gold chain around their neck. They are looking up with wide, intense eyes and a slightly open mouth, revealing their teeth, as if in surprise or shock. The background is dark and blurry, suggesting an outdoor, possibly nighttime, setting with indistinct foliage. The white overlay text from before remains visible on the screen.

The video features a series of short clips and images of XXXTentacion, alternating between introspective, dimly lit shots and energetic performance footage. Initially, X is seen in close-up, his face partially obscured by shadow with blurred, colorful lights in the background, looking contemplative. He is then shown in a black hoodie, holding a white rope, either looking down or gazing intently, his dreadlocks (initially dark with some lighter strands) visible. A shot of a person, likely X, playing drums on a stage appears briefly, with "LUDWIG" and "XAXS" visible on the bass drum. This is followed by a selfie-style video of X in a car, looking directly at the camera with a serious expression, his dreadlocks a distinct half-black, half-blonde style. The video then transitions to footage of X performing on a dimly lit stage, dressed in a plaid shirt and camouflage pants, facing a crowd illuminated by numerous phone lights. A static mugshot-style image of X is shown, where his dreadlocks are purple, and a small heart tattoo is visible near his eye, along with a tree tattoo on his forehead. This mugshot fades into the live performance scene, and the video cycles through the selfie video and live performance clips again.

The video opens with a brief shot of two men indoors, one in a green shirt standing and dancing, partially visible, and another in a white shirt sitting and looking down. This transitions to a split screen featuring XXXTENTACION on the left, recognizable by his blonde and black dreadlocks and facial tattoos, looking somber while wearing a plaid shirt and chains; the text "xxxtentacion" and "2 h" is visible above him. The right side shows the man in the white shirt from the previous scene. Following this, XXXTENTACION is seen at an iHeartRadio event, wearing a light denim jacket, sunglasses on his head, and multiple necklaces, speaking into a microphone with the "iHeart Radio" logo while gesturing with his hands against a black background with repeated "iHeart Radio" logos. The scene then shifts to XXXTENTACION outdoors at night, dressed in a black shirt, shaking hands and interacting with various people, with streetlights in the dark background. He is then shown in a closer shot indoors, holding a microphone labeled "103.5 THE BEAT" and gesturing with his hand near his temple, with a blurred image of a woman in the background. The video concludes with XXXTENTACION sitting alone in a dimly lit, dark room, wearing a dark hooded sweatshirt, looking down contemplatively and touching his chest, against a completely black background.

The video features XXXTentacion in various settings, starting with a close-up shot of him in a dark, outdoor-like environment, wearing a black and white plaid shirt and a thick gold chain, looking intently at the camera with grills visible in his mouth. The scene then shifts to him looking down and to the side in a warm, reddish-orange lit room with blurred bokeh lights in the background. He is next seen in a dark space, wearing a black hoodie with a white graphic print, holding a white rope, looking contemplative. A close-up of his face in red light highlights his face tattoos, including a small heart under his right eye, as he looks with a sad expression. He is shown again pulling the rope and looking around thoughtfully. The video then transitions to a performance scene where he is playing drums on a stage, with the text "Ludwig" and "XAXS" visible on the bass drum. Following this, he is in a car, recording himself with a serious expression, his distinct half-black, half-blonde dreadlocks clearly visible, while a blurred person is in the background. He is then seen performing on a stage, wearing a red and white plaid shirt and camouflage pants, holding a microphone, with a crowd enthusiastically waving their phone lights. The video concludes with a close-up of him in the car again, smiling and looking up, followed by another shot of him performing on stage.

The video montage features rapper XXXTentacion in various settings. It opens with him performing on a stage, holding a microphone while a crowd illuminates him with phone lights. This transitions to a split screen showing XXXTentacion in a close-up selfie with facial tattoos, and another young man sitting in a room, followed by a shot of XXXTentacion standing in a room with shelves. He is then seen giving an interview, speaking into a microphone with "103.5 BEAT" branding, against a backdrop of "iHeart RADIO" logos. The scene shifts to night, where he is outside, shaking hands with another young man while surrounded by a group of people, with faint blue and red lights in the background. He is again seen in the interview setting, speaking and gesturing, with a framed picture behind him. The video concludes with a contemplative shot of XXXTentacion in a dark hoodie, sitting in a dimly lit space, looking down at his hands.

The video segment opens with a close-up of a person, identified as XXXTentacion, featuring short, light-colored dreadlocks, facial tattoos including a small heart, and wearing a grey and white plaid shirt with a thick gold chain around his neck. He looks directly at the camera with an intense expression, then opens his mouth to reveal grills on his teeth. The background is dark and blurred, suggesting an outdoor night setting. This transitions to a profile shot of the same person wearing a dark hooded top, their face illuminated by a reddish-orange light, with blurry, warm-toned bokeh lights in the background as they look downward thoughtfully. The scene then shifts to a full-face shot of the person in a dark hoodie, holding and pulling on a thin white rope against a completely black background. A close-up of their face, bathed in red light, highlights their serious expression and facial tattoos before returning to the previous shot of them looking down while holding the rope. Next, a different person with blonde dreadlocks, wearing a dark top, is seen playing drums on a stage, with the word "Ludwig" and "XAXS" visible on the kick drum against a bright white background. This cuts back to XXXTentacion in a car, looking into the camera with his signature half-black, half-blonde dreadlocks and a black hoodie, with another person vaguely visible in the background. The video then introduces a new person, presumably the artist "Wave Season," who is shirtless under an unbuttoned yellow and black plaid shirt, wearing bright yellow oval sunglasses and a blue bandana as a headband. He dances energetically at night in what appears to be an outdoor court, with a distant street light and other men in the background. He then sings and gestures directly at the camera, showcasing his tattooed chest. The final shots show him dancing and moving with confidence against the dark background, then in a city setting at night with tall, purple-lit buildings, before returning to the outdoor court with another man beside him, all while his distinctive plaid shirt and yellow sunglasses remain prominent.

The video segment shows a man with distinctive half-blonde and half-black dreadlocks, wearing a black hoodie with a red graphic on the front. He is looking down with a serious or contemplative expression. In the blurred background, another individual with dark skin, wearing a dark shirt, is visible behind him, looking towards the right side of the frame. The setting appears to be inside a vehicle, indicated by the background elements.

The video opens with a close-up of a young man with dark skin, wearing a silver chain and shirtless, speaking intensely to the camera. He has short, dark hair with blonde highlights on top and small white accessories woven into it. A logo for "jd.aesthetics" is visible in the bottom left corner of the screen. He appears to be talking directly to the viewer, expressing strong opinions. The scene then transitions to a live concert with numerous people on stage under bright red lights. The main performer, likely the same man from the previous clip, is shirtless, wearing red pants, and holding a microphone while addressing the large audience, many of whom are holding up their phones to record.

The video captures a live performance on a stage dimly lit by vibrant red lights and several bright spotlights from above. A shirtless male performer with dreadlocks and red shorts stands center-stage, passionately speaking into a microphone. He is highly animated, frequently gesturing with his hands and arms, including pointing his index finger upwards as he delivers his message. Several young individuals, both male and female, are on stage around him, some clapping, others raising their hands, or simply watching him intently. A man in a dark t-shirt, camouflage pants, and a baseball cap stands to the performer's left. Below the stage, a large crowd is visible, their hands and cell phones raised in the air, recording and reacting with enthusiastic cheers. The performer continues his impassioned speech, at one point kneeling on his right knee to emphasize his words. Towards the end of the segment, the man in the camouflage pants steps onto a speaker to the performer's left, raising both arms above his head, further energizing the already excited crowd who respond with fervent cheers and more raised hands.

The video segment captures a dynamic concert performance within a dimly lit venue, dramatically illuminated by bright red and white stage lights. Center stage, a shirtless man with dreadlocks, wearing red shorts and green underwear, is the focal point, holding a microphone and gesturing animatedly with his hands. He engages the crowd directly, pointing and raising his arms, and at one point, he briefly jumps off the stage into the eagerly outstretched hands of the audience. Surrounding him on stage are several other individuals, including a man in a black t-shirt and camouflage pants to the right, and another person in a white hoodie to the left, along with a group of mostly young women standing behind the performer, all observing the energetic scene. Large speakers are visible on the left side of the stage. The audience in the foreground and on a balcony above is highly enthusiastic, with many individuals raising their hands, cheering, and actively recording the performance with their mobile phones, creating a lively and excited atmosphere.

The video opens on a concert stage with flashing red and blue lights, where a shirtless man in red shorts, likely XXXTentacion, stands amidst a group of people, turning his back to the audience while being handed a white towel. The excited crowd in the foreground raises their hands, some making "rock on" gestures and holding up phones. The scene then transitions to an indoor setting with a black backdrop featuring the "iHeart RADIO" logo. A young man with dreadlocks, wearing a light blue denim jacket, sunglasses on his head, and multiple chains, is holding a microphone and speaking directly to the camera with a serious expression. He then walks through a room with red walls and an American flag banner, briefly leaning down to interact with a young boy sitting at a table. The next shot shows the young man seated at a table, holding a microphone with "103.5" printed on it, addressing a small group of people who are listening attentively. Finally, he stands and gestures with the microphone towards a woman with long dark hair, continuing to speak while another man holds a microphone near the woman, all within the same indoor setting with red walls and "103.5 BEAT" visible on a background sign.

The video opens with a close-up of a man with blonde and dark dreadlocks, wearing a light jacket over a dark top and a chain, speaking intensely into a microphone that reads "103.5 BEAT" (referring to a radio station or media outlet). He gestures with his hands, emphasizing his words, and briefly wears white-framed sunglasses on top of his head before taking them off, while a blurred framed picture of him is visible in the background against a dark wall with red patterns. The scene then abruptly cuts to a nighttime outdoor setting where the same man, now wearing a black polo shirt with green and red trim and a black backpack, stands observing another man in a white T-shirt and silver chain who is handling a piece of black fabric, with other blurred people, parked cars, and palm trees visible under the glow of streetlights in the background.

In an outdoor night setting, illuminated by streetlights and what appear to be distant blue and red emergency lights, a young man with blonde dreadlocks, wearing a dark polo shirt and a dark harness, stands with a group of people. In the foreground, another young man in a white t-shirt and a dark vest, with short dark hair, is showing a black t-shirt with a white graphic design to the dreadlocked man. The dreadlocked man examines the shirt with a smile, takes it, and holds it up before he starts talking animatedly and gesturing with his hands. The man in the white shirt listens intently, occasionally smiling and nodding, and they shake hands, continuing their conversation. The dreadlocked man emphasizes a point by pointing his finger, while the other man maintains eye contact and listens. Other individuals are visible in the background, observing the interaction.

The video opens at night, outdoors, showing a man with blonde dreadlocks, wearing a dark shirt, intensely speaking and gesturing towards another man with dark hair, a white t-shirt, and a dark jacket draped over his shoulders. The man with dark hair listens attentively, occasionally nodding, as other people and cars are visible in the background under streetlights. The scene transitions to a close-up of the man with blonde and black dreadlocks (XXXTentacion) speaking to the camera, his expression serious and emotional, as if in a live stream. The screen is filled with user comments, some indicating "RIP" and expressing condolences ("I love you," "Thank you"), while others are more personal and raw, such as "I tried suicide" and "I support your mental state." A derogatory Russian comment, "ПИДОРАСЫ" (Pidorasy - "faggots"), is also visible, along with a watermark "RILEYTAUGOR" at the bottom left. The text "RIP Periscope" appears in the upper right corner, likely a comment or indication of the platform where the stream originated.
